layer_3_action.subject: Rapetosaurus
features: long, slender neck smoothly tapering up to a small, deep skull profile
cleanly closed mouth with an innocent, friendly neutral expression and large round eyes
distinctively wide, robust torso structure with a flat, low-slung back stance
long tapering tail held elevated off the ground in a smooth counterbalancing curve
smooth seamless matte clay-like skin with a vibrant, high-saturated color palette
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized Rapetosaurus with smooth clay-like skin stands on the sun-cracked light-grey mudflats, stretching its neck to stretch forward and munch on pine needles from the top of a small conifer tree.
